capabilities: track initiative and turn order during combat
manage creature HP, AC and status
calculate creature XP from level or challenge rating
create encounters in encounter code blocks
extras: The README states the documentation has moved to an external site.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to run tabletop RPG combat encounters or track turn order, health and stats during play.

relations.evidence: supports both custom and SRD creatures from the Fantasy Statblocks plugin

summary: TTRPG initiative tracker that runs combat encounters from encounter code blocks, tracking creature HP, AC, status and turn order.
